verses.en: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
verses.pt: Palavras de Jeremias, filho de Hilquias, um dos sacerdotes que estiveram em Anatote, na terra de Benjamim.
verses.en_web: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
verses.en_bbe: The words of Jeremiah, the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

verses.en: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.pt: Ao qual veio a palavra do SENHOR nos dias de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá, no décimo terceiro ano de seu reinado.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.en_bbe: To whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his rule.

verses.en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.pt: Veio também nos dias de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, até o fim do décimo primeiro ano de Zedequias, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, até que Jerusalém foi levada cativa no quinto mês.
verses.en_web: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.en_bbe: And it came again in the days of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, up to the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah; till Jerusalem was taken away in the fifth month.

verses.en: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: Veio, pois, a palavra do SENHOR a mim, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.pt: Antes que te formasse no ventre eu te conheci, e antes que saísses do útero eu te santifiquei, te dei por profeta às nações.
verses.en_web: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
verses.en_bbe: Before you were formed in the body of your mother I had knowledge of you, and before your birth I made you holy; I have given you the work of being a prophet to the nations.

verses.en: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
verses.pt: E eu disse: Ah! Senhor DEUS! Eis que não sei falar, pois sou um menino.
verses.en_web: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
verses.en_bbe: Then said I, O Lord God! see, I have no power of words, for I am a child.

verses.en: But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
verses.pt: Porém o SENHOR me disse: Não digas: sou menino; porque a todos a quem eu te enviar tu irás, e falarás tudo quanto eu te mandar.
verses.en_web: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord said to me, Do not say, I am a child: for wherever I send you, you are to go, and whatever I give you orders to say, you are to say.

verses.en: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Não temas diante deles, porque estou contigo para te livrar, diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Have no fear because of them: for I am with you, to keep you safe, says the Lord.

verses.en: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
verses.pt: Então o SENHOR estendeu sua mão, e tocou em minha boca. E o SENHOR me disse: Eis que tenho posto minhas palavras em tua boca.
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand, and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord put out his hand, touching my mouth; and the Lord said to me, See, I have put my words in your mouth:

verses.en: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
verses.pt: Olha que eu te pus neste dia sobre nações e sobre reinos, para arrancar e para derrubar, e para destruir e para arruinar, e para edificar e para plantar.
verses.en_web: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
verses.en_bbe: See, this day I have put you over the nations and over the kingdoms, for uprooting and smashing down, for destruction and overturning, for building up and planting.

verses.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
verses.pt: E a palavra do SENHOR veio a mim, dizendo: O que tu vês, Jeremias? E eu disse: Vejo uma vara de amendoeira.
verses.en_web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
verses.en_bbe: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Jeremiah, what do you see? And I said, I see a branch of an almond-tree.

verses.en: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
verses.pt: E disse-me o SENHOR: Viste bem; porque eu apresso minha palavra para cumpri-la.
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord said to me, You have seen well: for I keep watch over my word to give effect to it.

verses.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.
verses.pt: E veio a mim palavra do SENHOR segunda vez, dizendo: O que tu vês? E eu disse: Vejo uma panela fervente; e sua face está voltada para o norte.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? And I said, I see a boiling pot, and its face is from the north.

verses.en: Then the LORD said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.pt: Então o SENHOR me disse: Do norte o mal será solto sobre todos os moradores desta terra.
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord said to me, Out of the north evil will come, bursting out on all the people of the land.

verses.en: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.pt: Porque eis que eu convoco todas as famílias dos reinos do norte,diz o SENHOR; e virão, e cada um porá seu trono à entrada das portas de Jerusalém, e junto a todos seus muros ao redor, e em todas as cidades de Judá.
verses.en_web: For, behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: For see, I will send for all the families of the kingdoms of the north, says the Lord; and they will come, everyone placing his high seat at the way into Jerusalem, and against its walls on every side, and against all the towns of Judah.

verses.en: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
verses.pt: E pronunciarei meus juízos contra eles por causa de toda a sua maldade, pois me deixaram, e queimaram incenso a deuses estranhos, e se encurvaram a objetos de suas próprias mãos.
verses.en_web: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.
verses.en_bbe: And I will give my decision against them on account of all their evil-doing; because they have given me up, burning perfumes to other gods and worshipping the works of their hands.

verses.en: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.
verses.pt: Tu pois, prepara tua roupa, e te levanta-te; e fala-lhes tudo quanto eu te mandar; não tenhas medo diante deles, para que eu não te faça ter medo diante deles.
verses.en_web: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.
verses.en_bbe: So make yourself ready, and go and say to them everything I give you orders to say: do not be overcome by fear of them, or I will send fear on you before them.

verses.en: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
verses.pt: Porque eis que eu te ponho hoje como cidade fortificada, e como coluna de ferro, e como muro de bronze contra toda esta terra; contra os reis de Judá, seus príncipes, seus sacerdotes, e contra o povo desta terra.
verses.en_web: For, behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls, against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
verses.en_bbe: For see, this day have I made you a walled town, and an iron pillar, and walls of brass, against all the land, against the kings of Judah, against its captains, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

verses.en: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the LORD, to deliver thee.
verses.pt: E lutarão contra ti, mas não te vencerão; porque eu sou contigo, diz o SENHOR, para te livrar.
verses.en_web: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says Yahweh, “to rescue you.”
verses.en_bbe: They will be fighting against you, but they will not overcome you: for I am with you, says the Lord, to give you salvation.
